title: Piplup's First Bubble Beam
description: A proud Piplup raises one flipper to coax crystal bubbles from a turquoise tidepool. Its oversized rounded head, white eye masks, sparkling black eyes, twin bib buttons and golden bill overlook three-toed feet gripping a snowy ice floe. A little tail and dark blue cape complete the sculpture from behind.

sections.name: Round body and twin bib buttons
